runs.question: Will I get another kidney stone?
runs.answer:
To help prevent kidney stones, you can take several steps:
- Drink enough fluids to make at least 2.5 liters of urine a day [23].
- Limit added sugar and salt in your diet [47].
- Eat enough calcium-rich foods, but do not cut back on calcium from food [27].
- Avoid high-oxalate foods such as nuts, spinach, and rhubarb [25].
- Consider adding fresh lemon juice to your water, as it can help prevent new stones [46].

It's also a good idea to work with your doctor or a registered dietitian to create a personalized prevention plan based on your specific needs and the type of kidney stones you may have had. They might recommend medications or further dietary adjustments to reduce your risk of future stones.
